unsupported_types: Use a separate profile for documents, images, spatial rasters or text corpora; do not silently apply tabular denominators.

reliability.formula: 10 * passed_checks / 4, only if all four checks have been assessed
reliability.meaning: Evidence transparency; not a guarantee of factual accuracy

coverage.denominator: Explicit target geography x period x population/indicator units, with inapplicable combinations documented
coverage.note: An included row with missing values counts as present here; value validity is measured by completeness

freshness.basis: Observation period and source publication calendar, including normal publication lag
freshness.not_applicable: Historical/final one-off data: record a reason and keep the overall score null in this policy

completeness.note: Required fields and null tokens must be declared; 0 is not a missing value

unknown_permission: Discovery metadata only; no automatic mirroring, file delivery or join approval

never_assume: A table title identifies the required subseries

checks: FILE vs API vs LINK distribution
pagination and reported vs observed row counts
never_assume: All portal datasets have the same quality
A recent catalog modification means recent observations
The default query uses the requested age group
Different structural versions are backwards compatible

checks: Indicator, source ID and original producer
null observations, footnotes and modeled estimates
never_assume: A nonempty latest-value response proves complete time coverage
All countries have the same latest observation year
